name: composer/composer
description: Composer helps you declare, manage and install dependencies of PHP projects. It ensures you have the right stack everywhere.

suggest.ext-curl: Provides HTTP support (will fallback to PHP streams if missing)
suggest.ext-openssl: Enables access to repositories and packages over HTTPS
suggest.ext-zip: Allows direct extraction of ZIP archives (unzip/7z binaries will be used instead if available)
